responseMessageContents.text:
**Providing guidance on budget**

I should respond to the user based on their screenshot. I notice the top items show the Codespaces budget at $20 now. It’s important to scroll down to the Actions card to check the $10/20 budget since they only showed the Codespaces portion. I could suggest they send another screenshot if needed. We might also consider testing the GitHub rerun again, but we haven't confirmed if the Actions budget changed. Simple instructions will help!

You’re on the right page, but this screenshot shows the **Codespaces** budget changed to **$20**—not the Actions budget yet.

Please scroll down until you see the card labeled **Product: Actions**.

- If it says **$0 budget**, tap its **…** menu → **Edit budget** → set it to **$10** (or $20) → Save.
- If it already says **$10/$20 budget**, send me that screenshot or say **“Actions saved.”**

Only the **Actions** card controls IVX CI runners.
